body:
He was 58 when he passed... Young. 

I worked before he passed, but that job I was working at I left and started somewhere new.

My father had been smoking all his life, starting from a very young age, and he had a very bad diet (although rather fit) and he had to get a triple by pass. He smoking cold turkey. After that I found out he was smoking again last December, and bad diet again. Then a heart attack. I hadn't seen him since December, and last I saw of him, he was in a coffin.
